states.FULL: Begin with ordinary trend eligibility after warmup. Exit to OFF on actual account daily closing loss >= shock or drawdown from the current FULL episode NAV high >= drawdown. Episode anchors never change financial drawdown metrics, which retain the permanent account high-water mark.
states.OFF: Target all holdings to zero, including repeated blocked-exit attempts. Wait at least five sessions from exit and until observed account exposure is below 1%. A new probe additionally needs at least one fresh forty-session high. After an unsuccessful funded probe, wait ten sessions and require a sixty-session high; after two or more unsuccessful probes, a 120-session high. Failed-probe count is reset only after a funded probe succeeds.
states.PROBE: Allocate at most 25% of current NAV. Keep the probe's opening NAV anchor fixed, even when orders fail. A gain of at least 2% on actual account NAV, after at least three sessions and with at least 15% actual exposure and a healthy owned security, restores FULL. A loss of at least 1.5% on actual account NAV, a shock, or loss of all held trends returns to OFF and increments the failure counter. Paper profits and unfilled target weights cannot satisfy the funded-gain condition.

ownership: Use one raw log-momentum score .2/.4/.4 across 20/slow/2*slow sessions. New ordinary entries require close > EMA20, EMA20 > EMA60 and positive 20-session return. Existing holdings survive until close < EMA60*0.98 with negative 20-session return. At each twenty-session review, retain an eligible incumbent unless its score rank exceeds twice the configured position count; fill vacant slots in rank order. Between reviews only actual trend failures, vacancies or risk state changes justify targets. Intact holdings drift; deploy material idle cash; no symmetric volatility haircut or unrelated-universe veto.
execution: Unchanged adjusted-unit cash-conserving engine, prior-only capacity and next-open fills. Add a per-run policy factory instead of process-global monkeypatches. Validate every decision as finite nonnegative cash-funded weights. No leverage, broker orders, intraday stop fills, ticker rules or known-date switches.
selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
verification: Targeted tests for funded rather than hypothetical recovery, blocked exits, independent per-run state, next-open execution, future-prefix invariance and rejection of invalid weights. All sixteen training candidates and selected historical evaluation traces are retained with source, data, runner, protocol and runtime identities.
interpretation: Eighth authorized retrospective family. Earlier failures remain intact; this is not a new untouched holdout. Selection is confined to 2023-2025, and later comparisons retain the original economic goals. A selected candidate is not evidence of universal-subset or four-reference dominance.
